gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-smooch-sans: Metamorphous leaves generous space around every letter. Smooch Sans packs its lines tight, so the pair gets its character from that loose-versus-crowded tension, with a plain sans sitting under the display type.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sofia-sans-conden: Metamorphous carries a soft, visible shift between fat and slim strokes, with a high midline and roomy sidebearings. Sofia Sans Condensed answers with big, friendly lowercase.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-spline-sans-mono: Metamorphous has a high midline and strokes that taper gently as they bend and turn. Spline Sans Mono runs fixed-width and rope-like, so a long passage reads as a steady, mechanical tick beneath that softer heading.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 is a tall, blocky body whose ascenders look stubby for their height. And Metamorphous, with its soft fat-and-slim strokes, gives that plain sans a more commanding voice to sit under.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-truculenta: Truculenta is compact and rounded, with short ascenders and a tall x-height that feels like a blunt marker. Truculenta's tight, friendly body is the strongest thing here, set against Metamorphous with its mild stress in the o and e.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-ubuntu: Stately and slightly quirky up top, with a high midline and a gentle fat-to-slim stroke shift. Ubuntu's lofty lowercase band keeps the sans below it tidy.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-victor-mono: Metamorphous opens with a commanding look and generous sidebearings. It does display best, with modest thick-thin contrast, while Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing and open-sided bowls, handles the steady text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-viga: A high midline and hairlines that are present but not razor thin give Metamorphous its commanding look. Viga is drawn with one pen tip, a plain sans, and Metamorphous earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-voces: Metamorphous is commanding, with large sidebearings and a high-set midline. It does display best, while Voces, a plain sans with tall lowercase and close stem-to-hairline ratio, does the quiet text work.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, which gives the sans-serif a dense, level line. Metamorphous adds a medium-key contrast above it.
